raw_inverse.after: "notes": "The Lord's Prayer in its devotional form (Mt 6:9-13 as received in the liturgy). Wording transcribed verbatim from witness do-missa, whose quotidiánum differs from the cotidiánum of the 1962 Ordo Missae (approved Benziger printing, pp. 310-311), and the Latin basis of this devotional text is an open editorial decision; the final Amen is the priest's quiet response in the Ordo, standard in the devotional form."

raw_inverse.after: "notes": "The threefold Agnus Dei of the Ordo Missae in its ordinary form, said at the commixture before Communion. Rubric s01 quotes the 1962 rubric as the approved Benziger printing sets it (Ordo Missae, p. 313); rubric s05 quotes, from the same page, the rubric for Masses for the dead, whose variant petitions (dona eis réquiem, sempitérnam) are a different recension, encoded as ordinarium.agnus-dei-defunctorum."

raw_inverse.after: "notes": "The Lord's Prayer as the Mass sets it: the preface Orémus. Præcéptis salutáribus móniti, the prayer said by the priest alone as far as tentatiónem, the server's Sed líbera nos a malo, and the priest's Amen — the Ordo's page rubric says secrete, the Ritus servandus (X, 1) submissa voce; the edition follows the page rubric and records the disagreement for the expert. The words of the prayer are RE-ENCODED here rather than referenced. The corpus already carries orationes.pater-noster, the same prayer in its devotional form, in the same words; it spells quotidiánum where this text follows the 1962 page with cotidiánum at w034, and it is pointed differently at six places (this text's w016, w019, w022, w028, w037 and w054). But that document is one continuous text said by one voice, while this one is a dialogue — the last petition belongs to another speaker — wrapped in a preface and divided by three rubrics. Those are two recensions of one prayer, which is what the variant field is for, and the corpus already keeps recension pairs apart with their own word ids (ordinarium.confiteor and ordinarium.confiteor-sacerdotis, ordinarium.misereatur and ordinarium.misereatur-tui — those pairs differ in wording; this pair differs only in one spelling and six punctuation marks). The schema has no field by which one text could borrow another's words, and a reference would leave a hole in the middle of a prayer the reader is praying. MÓNITI at w004 and FORMÁTI at w008 are participles, not adjectives: neither analyzer heads an adjective monitus or formatus, only the verbs and nouns of their own (monitus, -us — a reminding) that are not the adjective claimed. AUDÉMUS at w009 is present indicative; audeo is semi-deponent, so only its perfect system is deponent in form. NE at w050 is the prohibitive adverb, as the corpus rules it elsewhere."
